title: Packaged automation: a flow disabled by deployment policy shows a status chip; the policy is explained once
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/automation/packaged` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`): each scheduled flow the deployment policy keeps off (Campaign Auto-Completion, Case SLA Monitor, …) renders a six-line paragraph inside its table row — "disabled by deployment policy — package-authored scheduled work is off on this deployment (OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED is unset or not truthy), so no time trigger arms and no packaged `defineJob` is scheduled. This is not a binding failure and nothing about the flow needs fixing: set OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true … It is OFF by default in every posture — a clock-driven workload's cost is a fact about the deployment, not about the flow." — repeated verbatim per flow, while the row's switch still reads On.

## Target

1. The row shows one status chip after the flow name: "Off by deployment policy" (muted, with a clock icon); the switch reflects the effective state (off, disabled) with the objectui#12303 tooltip reason.
2. One banner above the table, shown once when at least one flow is policy-disabled: "Scheduled flows are off on this deployment. Set OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true to run package-authored scheduled work." with a link to the docs page; the long paragraph moves into the chip's tooltip or the banner's "Why" disclosure.
3. Rows stay 40 px; the table scans as a table again.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`, `PackagedActionsSection.tsx` if it shares the row, `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a policy-disabled flow renders the chip and no paragraph in the row; the banner renders once for two disabled flows and not at all for none.
2. Screenshot at 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- The policy text comes from the server's answer; the console shortens the display, not the server's reason.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-packaged-automation.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-packaged-automation.png?raw=true).

The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
